metadata.description: Kamil Kuklewski's Claude Code plugins: practical skills for web development, QA and AI-assisted engineering.

plugins.name: site-audit
plugins.description: Pre-launch and regression audit of a website: SEO, Core Web Vitals, accessibility, responsiveness, semantic HTML. Audits every page type, writes a tracked was→now checklist and re-checks it later.

plugins.name: ladder-adoption
plugins.description: DEPRECATED, use simple-brain-assess. Find your rung on the Steps of AI Adoption and the next one up; incident-response loop to earn the next rung.

plugins.name: seo-content
plugins.description: Turn Google Search Console data into content opportunities and review-ready blog drafts — quick wins, cannibalisation, decaying pages, optional competitor gaps — without a Semrush/Ahrefs subscription. Every user brings their own keys.

plugins.name: motion-editor
plugins.description: Build a local, deterministic motion-graphics editor app (Vite + React + Canvas renderFrame, Playwright + ffmpeg MP4 export) from a strict spec — asks for your resources and look-reference examples first.

plugins.name: simple-brain-assess
plugins.description: Assess an AI second brain (personal or company knowledge base) against a proven simple-brain model: flow, structure, trust, ownership, decision bottlenecks and enterprise governance; read-only report plus the smallest next step.
